an3.42:1.1: “Bhikkhus, in three cases one may be understood to have faith and confidence.
an3.42:1.3: When one desires to see those of virtuous behavior; when one desires to hear the good Dhamma; and when one dwells at home with a mind devoid of the stain of miserliness, freely generous, openhanded, delighting in relinquishment, devoted to charity, delighting in giving and sharing.
an3.42:1.4: In these three cases, one may be understood to have faith and confidence.”
an3.42:2.1: One who desires to see the virtuous ones,
an3.42:2.2: who wishes to hear the good Dhamma,
an3.42:2.3: who has removed the stain of miserliness,
an3.42:2.4: is called a person endowed with faith.
